set -e
.venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import json,sqlite3,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone
from collections import Counter
from GSE.curation.lexicon_builder.epoch import fingerprint,record
n=Path('docs/readings/2026-11-13-ssl-explicit-genera'); cp=n/'ssl-api-coverage-canonical-reconciliation.json'; c=json.loads(cp.read_text()); db=Path('data/lexicon_builder/2026-11-12/ssl-explicit-genera/ssl-api-checkpoint/candidate-self-boundary.db')
meaning={
 'people':('Collective animate','The exact native sense explicitly denotes human beings collectively, not an arbitrary grammatical plural.'),
 'body':('Physical embodiment','The exact native sense denotes the entire physical structure of an organism, not a text body or organized association.'),
 'words':('Linguistic content','The exact native sense denotes an identifiable unit of language, within the approved WORDS linguistic-content boundary, not an unspecified SAY event.'),
 'parts':('Part-whole relation','The exact native sense is determined by inclusion in a whole. Singular PART corresponds to this relation; no HAVE or participant content follows.'),
 'kinds':('Category/type','The exact native definition is a category distinguished by common characteristics; this is the taxonomic KIND meaning, not kindness.'),
 'same':('Positive IDENTITY pole SAME','The complete native definition is same in identity, exactly the positive identity pole.'),
 'other':('Negative IDENTITY pole OTHER','The native definition explicitly denies sameness of identity. The fixed bipolar declaration represents this content as SAME=-1, not negation of unrelated banks.'),
 'one':('Singular','The native definition explicitly specifies a single unit and excludes two or more; no NUMBER/hierarchy assignment is made.'),
 'two':('Dual/minimal plural','The native cardinal sense is one more than one: exactly TWO, not a generic unspecified plural. No NUMBER/hierarchy assignment is made.'),
 'true':('Positive TRUTH pole TRUE','The exact native definition states consistency with fact or reality and not false; exactly the fixed positive truth pole.'),
 'think':('Cognitive processing','The primary unit THINK permits thinking about an entity or thinking like this. Its own cognitive processing is the bank meaning; no GOOD/BAD or participant content is projected.'),
 'feel':('Affective/sensory','The primary FEEL unit permits good/bad feeling and feeling in a body part. FEEL names the experience itself; no GOOD/BODY value is imported and no about-valency is invented.'),
 'say':('Speech act','The primary SAY unit is saying something to/about someone. Only the speech act is projected, not WORDS or the content/recipient banks.'),
 'move':('Change of location','The primary MOVE unit is movement of someone/something or a body part in a place, corresponding to change of location. No agent, body, goal or spatial participant banks are imported.'),
 'touch':('Contact relation','The primary TOUCH unit denotes contact between entities/body parts. Only the contact relation is projected, without importing the entities or BODY.'),
 'moment':('Punctual time','The exact MOMENT unit supports in one moment/at this moment and before/after a moment; its punctual-time content matches MOMENT, not a duration or participant assignment.'),
 'now':('Negative TEMPORAL_REF pole NOW','The primary NOW unit locates an occurrence at the time of saying this now. The explicit fixed THEN/NOW bipolar declaration gives this unit THEN=-1; not BEFORE or arbitrary temporal content.'),
 'far':('Positive DISTANCE pole FAR','The primary FAR relation is distance from a place. It matches the explicit positive FAR/NEAR distance pole, without copying place arguments.'),
 'near':('Negative DISTANCE pole NEAR','The primary NEAR relation is proximity to a place/person. The explicit FAR/NEAR bipolar declaration gives FAR=-1, not zero or an identity claim about ordinary near senses.')}
claims=[]; inventory=[]
with sqlite3.connect(db.resolve().as_uri()+'?mode=ro',uri=True) as con:
 for u in c['units']:
  key=u['unit_id'].split(':')[-1]; e=u['entry']['entry_id']; bank=u['own_bank']; pole=u['own_pole']
  if key in meaning:
   row=con.execute('SELECT lemma,pos,gloss FROM lexemes WHERE sense_id=?',(e,)).fetchone();assert row==tuple(u['entry'][k] for k in ['lemma','pos','definition']),(e,row)
   before=json.loads(con.execute('SELECT domains FROM definition_states WHERE entry_id=?',(e,)).fetchone()[0]);assert before[bank]==[-1,0,1],e
   expected_source='nsm_chart' if e.startswith('nsm_chart:') else 'wordnet_hierarchy'
   native=[json.loads(r[0]) for r in con.execute('SELECT payload FROM source_observations WHERE entry_id=? AND source=?',(e,expected_source))];assert len(native)==1,e; native=native[0]
   assert native['features']['definition']==u['entry']['definition'] and native['candidate_entry_ids']==[e]
   claims.append({'unit_id':u['unit_id'],'entry_id':e,'bank':bank,'value':pole,'chart_heading':u['chart_heading'],'forms':u['forms'],'frame_text':u['frame_text'],'definition':u['entry']['definition'],'pos':u['entry']['pos'],'bank_meaning':meaning[key][0],'derivation':meaning[key][1],'native_source':expected_source,'native_record_id':native['record_id'],'native_observation_sha256':hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(native,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest(),'identity_link':u['explicit_identity_link'],'scope':'EXACT_SOURCE_DEFINITION_AND_OWN_COORDINATE_ONLY'})
   classification='SOURCE_CORRESPONDENCE_PROPOSED_INDEPENDENT_WITNESS_PENDING'
  elif u['own_domain'] is not None and len(u['own_domain'])==1:classification='OWN_COORDINATE_ALREADY_INSTALLED'
  elif pole is None:classification='HIERARCHY_OR_CONSTRUCTION_NO_SCALAR_ASSIGNMENT'
  elif e.startswith('gse_closed_class:'):classification='GRAMMATICAL_RELATION_VERIFY_COMPOSITION_NOT_RAW_BANK_GAP'
  else:classification='ADAPTED_OR_CONSTRUCTION_MEANING_REQUIRES_SEPARATE_REVIEW'
  inventory.append({'unit_id':u['unit_id'],'entry_id':e,'own_bank':bank,'own_pole':pole,'classification':classification})
assert len(claims)==19 and len(inventory)==65,(len(claims),len(inventory))
pins=['data/external/references/nsm-primes-chart-v20-2022.txt','GSE/primitives_v2.py','GSE/curation/schema.py','GSE/curation/lexicon_builder/nsm_catalog.py']
# Catalogue module name is verified from its repository path, not guessed authority.
if not Path(pins[-1]).exists():pins.pop()
review={'format':'GSE.canonical-source-correspondence-review/1','created_utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'role_scope':'ASSIGNMENT A — COMPLETE AND EXECUTE THE CONNECTED SSL LEARNER (primary integration ownership)','review_kind':'DEFINITIONAL_DERIVATION_NOT_NEW_FOUNDER_POLICY','status':'SOURCE_REVIEWED_INDEPENDENT_TYPED_WITNESSES_PENDING','baseline':{'path':str(db),'sha256':fingerprint(db)},'source_pins':{p:fingerprint(Path(p)) for p in pins},'census':{'path':str(cp),'sha256':fingerprint(cp),'authority':'FACTUAL_IDENTITY_AND_STATE_INVENTORY_NOT_SEMANTIC_APPROVAL'},'claims':claims,'whole_65_unit_inventory':inventory,'inventory_counts':dict(Counter(x['classification'] for x in inventory)),'nonclaims':['No full signature, default zero, hierarchy or NUMBER assignments.','No spelling-to-prime runtime fallback or frame-compatibility identity.','No transfer to other senses or source IDs.','Every non-own cell stays unknown unless existing independently admitted closure entails a value.'],'remaining_adapted_questions':['DIE is an event transition, not automatically the DEAD state.','LIVE needs sense-specific vitality versus residence distinction.','BE specification/location and existential THERE IS must preserve distinct construction roles.','MINE includes reference and possession; do not flatten the construction to HAVE.','TIME/PLACE deixis versus temporal/spatial entity roles need exact correspondence.','LONG/SHORT TIME and SIDE are source constructions; retain composed relations.'],'bank_writes':0,'activation':False}
record(n/'ssl-api-controller-canonical-source-review.json',review)
print(json.dumps({'claims':len(claims),'inventory_counts':review['inventory_counts'],'review_sha256':fingerprint(n/'ssl-api-controller-canonical-source-review.json')}))
